detail: No registered capability reads pilot.observations.json, computes exact row/site totals and completion percent, and persists both digest.json and digest.md, so the competence was acquired as a self-contained Node script using only the Node 22 standard library (node:fs, node:path, node:crypto). Nothing was installed, no network or package manager was touched, and no host configuration changed. The procedure was qualified by real execution against the fixture: it produced row_count=3, scheduled=30, completed=26, incidents=6, completion_percent=86.67 with sites North (rows 2, 22/18/5, 81.82) and South (rows 1, 8/8/1, 100.00). Arithmetic was independently cross-checked with a separate Python implementation using Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP and matched on every field. Fail-closed behaviour was verified on five malformed inputs (empty observations, completed>scheduled, invalid JSON, string count, wrong argument count) - each exited 1 and wrote no output files. Output is deterministic: two runs produced byte-identical digest.json. The proposed target itself was not executed during acquisition; only the separate probe invocation was.
